asset.name: DocuSign
asset.description: Your DocuSign account (developer sandbox by default). On install paste an access token, or switch the connection to JWT Grant or OAuth in Connectors → DocuSign and set the base URL of your account (www.docusign.net or your region's host for production). Register the Connect webhook afterwards so signatures arrive at once (see /docs/integrations/e-signature); without it the Wait for signature step polls every 5 minutes.
